title: The Devil and Mr. O
paragraphs: Arch Oboler-hosted syndicated revival/repackaging of earlier Oboler radio plays, chiefly Lights Out material. The frozen GRH set is a clean 26-week Friday sequence from Sep. 17, 1971 through Mar. 10, 1972; Library of Congress archival description documents a broader 1971-73 Devil and Mr. O series context.
GRH documents the program through Broader documented syndicated revival era (1971 to 1973) and 26-week frozen GRH release sequence (September 17, 1971 to March 10, 1972).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Arch Oboler (host on 26 recordings and writer on 26 recordings), Mercedes McCambridge (performer on 4 recordings), Bea Benaderet (performer on 2 recordings), Cathy Lewis (performer on 2 recordings), Mary Jane Croft (performer on 2 recordings), Ann Shephard (performer on 1 recording), and Byron Kane (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Arch Oboler radio horror revival, horror, dread and the macabre, death, mortality and survival, supernatural and occult threat, science fiction and speculative danger, and transformation, identity and human nature.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Revival of prewar and wartime Lights Out material, Syndication sales/audition package, 26-week 1971-72 syndicated sequence, and Broader 1971-73 Devil and Mr. O archive era.
